criterion_text: Explicit workspace choice overrides Project Location; otherwise a matching Project Existing Location is selected; otherwise Session-name auto-allocation is used. Wrong-Agent paths, unavailable Agents, missing directories and unauthorized explicit selections fail with actionable states, without hidden fallback or deletion of any external directory.

verifiers.summary: The Agent-side Project Location and managed-resolution rules are proven

evidence.value: exact SHA a358f9a62b2664ad396fdf6b2f0859d5167f847c: the Agent accepted only a real, canonical Project Location directory, refused a symlinked or missing location, refused a location combined with a Project EROFS lower, and persisted the managed Workspace lower pin across resolution

verifiers.summary: Server-side Workspace selection precedence and fail-closed routing are proven

evidence.value: exact SHA a358f9a62b2664ad396fdf6b2f0859d5167f847c: an explicit managed selection outranked the Project Location; auto selected the matching Project Location on the target Agent; a location declared only on another Agent, and an offline Agent were refused with actionable states; Enter forwarded only the resolved path and no lower grant for an external Project Location
